facts.fact: Camerounlink/Agence Ecofin (1 Sep 2026) states Cameroon is the Central African Republic's main gateway to submarine cables via the Central Africa Backbone, and that the planned Congo-Brazzaville interconnection (WACS, 2Africa) remains to be realised per a ministry official on 30 Aug 2026; a Cameroon fibre cut disrupted CAR internet the week before.

systems.owner: Congo Telecom and Silicone Connect (operators of the Congo fibre)

note: Contradicts the 12 Oct 2026 Ecofin record on whether the Congo link is in service; the Cameroon cut was a temporary outage, not none.
